title: Uruguayan-Style Grilled Fish with Ceviche
description: A refreshing and flavorful dish that combines the best of Uruguayan cuisine with the zesty flavors of ceviche.
instructions: 1. In a blender or food processor, combine lime juice, white onion, cilantro, aji amarillo pepper, black pepper, and salt. Blend until smooth.
2. Place the fish fillets in a large bowl and pour the ceviche-style marinade over them. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
3. Preheat grill to medium-high heat. Remove the fish from the marinade and cook for 4-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
4. Meanwhile, toast the light crustless bread slices until lightly browned.
5. To serve, place a cooked fish fillet on each bread slice. Garnish with fresh cilantro leaves and serve immediately.
6. Serve the remaining ceviche-style marinade on the side as a sauce.
